prompt: Ruth 'Static' Calloway is seen from BEHIND — the back of the head and the shoulders toward the lens, facing INTO the place, which opens away from them into the depth of the frame, stepping into the space — Electronic-warfare specialist, tactical response unit, A wiry woman in her fifties with a shaved head, sun-creased skin, pale eyes, and a cochlear implant behind her left ear., Faded olive field shirt and plate carrier, cargo trousers, dusty boots, a respirator hanging at her neck and sealed goggles pushed up on her forehead.
